q012026-11-10: not rechecked

All-in cost per parcel

List price per parcel for a B2C delivery to a home address, duty-paid where the service can do it: freight at the card's next weight break, fuel (also on the fees it applies to), the fees charged on every parcel (trigger always), and the carrier's duty-paid fee when the border rule says duty or tax is due there. Duties and taxes themselves are left out: they are the same whichever carrier carries the parcel. Fees that depend on the event (remote area, address correction, inspections) and optional ones (insurance, pickup, residential notification at DHL, FedEx third-party billing) are left out. Where a border limit includes shipping (MY, KR, CH), the carrier's freight and fuel stand in for the shipping the buyer pays. Each part is converted to US$ and then summed, display only. VND converted at 26,300 per US$ (research/logistics/02, estimate), other currencies at the ECB reference rates of 2026-11-06, rounded half up to whole dollars.

  • ≥: a part is missing (e.g. fuel or a duty-paid fee not known), so the total is a lower bound.
  • DAP: duty or tax is due at the border and the service does not pay it, so the buyer would pay at the door. Not usable for us as merchant of record.
  • DDP?: duty or tax may be due and the service's duty-paid terms are unknown.
  • incl. VAT: the card's prices include Vietnamese VAT, unlike most others; shown as quoted, not adjusted. Where a card's prices include fuel, the fuel part is zero.
  • Cell colour is the worst status among the parts and the border rule. The billed weight is the greater of the actual and the volumetric weight of the reference box.
  • Discount: the share off freight (fuel follows net freight, fees stay) at which the express list price equals the cheapest economy line that is published (verified or secondary), complete and duty-paid on that lane. 'Fees alone exceed it': no freight discount is enough.

Border rules used

PlaceCategoryDuty or tax at the borderAboveValue testedStatusSourceQuestionNotes
SGaboveSGD 400.00goodsVerified (primary source)IRAS e-Tax Guide OVR, 5th ed., §5.4assumes we are OVR-registered (GST at sale up to S$400 per item); no duty on our categories
MYaboveMYR 500.00goods_plus_freightSecondary sourcelogistics guidance; Grant Thornton MYq13RM 500 CIF per consignment by air courier; assumes LVG registration (tax at sale below it)
THalwaysgoodsSecondary sourceTilleke & Gibbins; EY; BDOno de minimis since 2026-01-01: 7% VAT and duty from the first baht
PHabovePHP 10,000.00goodsWaiting on a questionDHL PH de minimis guideq12PHP 10,000 FOB per shipment by statute; whether VAT is still collected below it is unknown
IDalwaysgoodsVerified (primary source)Kemenkeu JDIH, abstract of PMK 4/2025VAT on every consignment; duty only below FOB US$3 waived
JPaboveJPY 16,666goodsEstimate or ratingJapan Customs FAQ 1006derived: the verified ¥10,000 customs-value limit, with personal-use imports valued at 60% of the retail price, means about ¥16,666 retail
JPapparelalwaysgoodsVerified (primary source)Japan Customs FAQ 1006knitted apparel is taxed at any value; woven apparel follows the general row
JPleather_footwearalwaysgoodsVerified (primary source)Japan Customs FAQ 1006
KRaboveUSD 150.00goods_plus_freightVerified (primary source)Korea Customs Service, list clearanceq19US$150 customs value including shipping, all-or-nothing; same-day shipments may be combined
AUaboveAUD 1,000.00goodsVerified (primary source)ATO, GST on low value imported goodsassumes we are registered for LVG GST (ARN), so GST is charged at sale up to A$1,000
NZaboveNZD 1,000.00goodsVerified (primary source)NZ Customs; IRDassumes GST registration; per item
USalwaysgoodsVerified (primary source)Federal Register 2026-12669 / 2026-12670Section 321 de minimis suspended for all countries
CAaboveCAD 20.00goodsVerified (primary source)CBSA Customs Notice 20-18CAD 20 for goods not of US or Mexico origin
EUalwaysgoodsVerified (primary source)TAXUD guidance 2026-06-08; Reg. (EU) 2026/382flat EUR 3 duty per tariff line from 2026-07-01 (VAT at sale under IOSS up to EUR 150, so only the duty is paid at the border below that)
GBaboveGBP 135.00goodsSecondary sourceGOV.UK LVI reform policy paperup to £135 VAT at sale and duty relieved (until October 2028 at the latest)
CHaboveCHF 61.73goods_plus_freightEstimate or ratingresearchderived: import VAT waived when it is at most CHF 5, i.e. 8.1% of about CHF 61.73; no duty on industrial products

Landed cost per parcel

The all-in carrier price split into its parts, plus the duties, customs fees and taxes on the parcel from landed_rates.csv, for the reference parcels' product category. Amounts in US$, exact until rounded for display. Hover a cell for its parts, notes and status. VND converted at 26,300 per US$ (research/logistics/02, estimate), other currencies at the ECB reference rates of 2026-11-06, rounded half up to whole dollars.

  • Who pays: checkout = we collect it from the buyer at checkout through the country's seller scheme and pay it ourselves; carrier = collected at the border and billed to us by a duty-paid service; buyer = collected from the buyer at the door by a duties-unpaid service (not usable for us as merchant of record); ? = the service's duty-paid terms are unknown.
  • Duties and taxes use one figure per destination and category (see each row's note for the end of a range taken). Free-trade preferences (ATIGA, EVFTA, ...) are not assumed. Taxes are charged on goods, freight and the duties and fees before them; the carrier's freight and fuel stand in for the shipping the buyer pays.
  • Landed total: carrier total plus every duty, fee and tax, whoever pays it. ≥: a part is missing, so it is a lower bound.

SG MY TH PH ID AU GB US). MFN by default; FTA rates only where duty is eliminated and only with a certificate of origin, for 24 agreements incl. AFTA and AANZFTA (no EVFTA, CPTPP, RCEP). No US sales tax, no rule-version field. Free plan 3 calculations a month (web, no card); API from Plus EUR 75/month (2,000 calls); no sandbox. fedex_ficp_vn_2026_promo promo · VND · Verified (primary source)

Verified (primary source) Valid 2026-01-05 to open. Received 10-Nov-2026; needs an account. Fuel: charged on top. VAT: not stated. FedEx VN 2026 FICP promotional export rates, sources/fedex/fedex-rates-ficp-exp-en-vn-2026.pdf · sources/fedex/README.md

also excludes special fees; for VN FedEx account holders in good standing who settle invoices promptly in VN (Miscellaneous Information, sur PDF); 0.5-20 kg loaded; no Envelope or Pak rates; no dangerous goods; zones assumed equal to IP (zone index has no FICP column)

dhl_ewceramicsallowedUnverified or conflictingpackaging must be adequate for ordinary care (T&C §2); liability per the VN annex 9 SDR/kg (min 30 SDR) for airline-carried postal items, else 5 SDR/kg, general T&C 26 SDR/kg (Montreal); no explicit fragile exclusion, but §9 excludes defects or characteristics of the goods; ask (q35)https://mydhl.express.dhl/vn/en/legal/terms-and-conditions.html
dhl_ewwoodunknownWaiting on a questionnot mentioned; fumigation, ISPM-15 and phytosanitary handling unknown (q35); destination rules apply regardless (e.g. AU)DHL VN prohibited and restricted items pages
dhl_ewlacquerwareunknownWaiting on a questionnot mentioned; lacquer finish and wood core as for wood (q35)DHL VN prohibited and restricted items pages
fedex_ipapparelallowedSecondary sourcenot restricted in the surcharge sheet; a package not in a corrugated cardboard box (e.g. a poly mailer) pays the additional handling surcharge VND 679,700sources/fedex/fedex-rates-sur-en-vn-2026.pdf
fedex_ipkeycapsallowedSecondary sourcewired boards and keycaps are not dangerous goods; boards with lithium batteries: inaccessible dangerous goods VND 1,501,500 or 21,000/kg where fully regulated; Section II rules not in the sheet (q02)sources/fedex/fedex-rates-sur-en-vn-2026.pdf
fedex_iekeycapsallowedSecondary sourcewired only: dangerous goods may not be shipped via International Economy (sheet note 3)sources/fedex/fedex-rates-sur-en-vn-2026.pdf
fedex_ipceramicsallowedUnverified or conflictingliability the greater of about US$20/kg or US$100 per shipment unless value is declared (VND 46,800 per VND 2,100,000 above the free amount); outer box must be cardboard; fragile exclusion and packing rules not read (FedEx VN pages block automated reads; q02)sources/fedex/fedex-rates-sur-en-vn-2026.pdf
ups_saverapparelallowedSecondary sourcenot restricted in the rate guide; an article not fully in corrugated cardboard (incl. soft plastic bags) pays additional handling VND 423,940 per packagesources/ups/service-guide-vn-gb-en.pdf
ups_saverkeycapsallowedSecondary sourcewired boards and keycaps not dangerous goods; inaccessible dangerous goods (Class 9 lithium) VND 1,499,300 per shipment or 136,300 per package, contract service; Section II not stated (q03)sources/ups/service-guide-vn-gb-en.pdf
